name: CTA Booking Newsletter
description: Shared band above the footer: book now and newsletter sign-up with Bonvoy caption. No props; all instances identical.

name: Hero Fullbleed Centered
description: Shared page hero: full-bleed section, optional background image, logo, eyebrow, heading, text and chamfer button. Pick the look with the Variant prop. Content and visibility are props.

name: Footer Links
description: Shared site footer: five link columns (the dining venues come from the CMS), copyright, Tribute Portfolio logo and studio credit over a background image. No props; all instances identical.

name: Gallery Mosaic Captioned
description: Full-bleed gallery mosaic with a heading and an Items slot of Gallery Mosaic Item tiles.

name: Map Feature
description: Script heading tilted over a hand-drawn map, text and outline button. Set Image on each instance. Map Feature Image Bg and Map Feature Centered are separate components.

name: Split image text light
description: Split image text section: image on one side, heading, text and optional button on the other. Pick the look with the Variant prop. Second image, Caption, Header and Footer can be shown or hidden. Compact, Edge, Stagger and Wide layouts are separate components.

name: Image Trio Text
description: Full-bleed trio of portrait images with centred heading, paragraph and button. The card layouts are separate components: Image Trio Text Left and Image Trio Text Left Offset.

name: script-intro-centered
description: Centered script-heading intro. Pick the look with the Variant prop. Content and Show image, Show paragraph, Show back link are props.

name: image-inset-single
description: Inset image on a cream section. Props: Variant (Base, Small), image, image alt. Small narrows the image for posts.

name: timeline-scatter-images
description: Centred heading over a scattered list of images with captions. Items slot: add one Scatter Image Item per image.

name: tab-pills-intro
description: Script heading, paragraph and a burgundy tab pill. Tabs slot: put a Collection List of categories in it. Pick the look with the Variant prop.

name: Venue Card Fullbleed Tall
description: Edge-to-edge venue card, about square: large heading, text and outline button. Optional logo, night image, video and text.

name: Venue Card Fullbleed Left
description: Edge-to-edge 16:9 card (Home): content bottom left, button on the right, and three fixed tabs. The props set the first tab only.

name: Site Nav
description: Shared navbar and full-screen menu with the day and night buttons. Base is light text over a hero; Dark is for light pages.

name: Map Feature Image Bg
description: Map fills the section with a tan card bottom left: heading, text and the Map Places list from the CMS. Set Image on each instance.

name: Map Feature Centered
description: Centred heading and text with a wide illustration below. Set Image on each instance.

name: Image Trio Text Left
description: Heading on top with three contained cards: image, eyebrow title and rich text.

name: Image Trio Text Left Offset
description: Image Trio Text Left with staggered cards: the first and third sit lower on desktop and tablet.

name: Article Card Staggered Tall
description: Two columns: heading and intro left, square cards right. Cards slot: add one Article Card Tall Item per card.

name: Card Carousel Header Left
description: Cream card carousel: heading, text and arrows left, staggered link cards right. Cards slot: add one Card Carousel Card per card or a Collection List. Pick the look with the Variant prop.

name: Overlay Detail Panel Modal
description: Pop-up dialog with image, details and up to five items. Pick the look with the Variant prop. Used only by the old Arts pop-ups.

name: Booking Menu
description: Book Now panel (dialog id book) and the Reserve a table venue list (dialog id book-table). Place once per page after the footer; every #book link opens it.

name: Art Detail Modal
description: Arts page CMS dialog. Copy of Overlay Detail Panel Modal without the venues Collection List, so it can sit inside the art Collection Lists.

name: Gallery Canvas Styles
description: Gallery canvas layout CSS for /gallery and /arts. Source: docs/reference/site-head/gallery-canvas.css (paste minified).

name: Legal Rich Text Styles
description: Rich text child styles (headings, spacing, lists) for legal pages on the static-template layout. Source: docs/reference/site-head/legal-rich-text.css (paste minified). Place first in main on every legal page.

name: Split image text slider
description: Split image text with an image slider (History). Add one Split Image Slide per photo in the Slides slot; any number.

name: Card Carousel Card
description: One card for the Cards slot of Card Carousel Header Left (More of the Guild): image, label, page link. Heights stagger automatically by position.

name: Gallery Mosaic Item
description: One tile for the Items slot of Gallery Mosaic Captioned: image (or video), alt, caption. Photos sit in pairs, half width; a last photo with no partner goes full width. Numbers count automatically.

name: Scatter Image Item
description: One item for the Items slot of timeline-scatter-images: image, alt, caption. Size and position follow the item's place in the list (small, large right, xsmall inset, medium centre, repeating).

name: Article Card Tall Item
description: One card for the Cards slot of Article Card Staggered Tall: image, heading, text.

name: Corporate Services Card
description: One card for the Cards slot of Corporate & Services: image, title, text.

name: Corporate & Services
description: Corporate & Services (Neighborhood): heading, a Cards slot of Corporate Services Card, caption and button.

name: Key Features Item
description: One bullet for the Features slot of Key Features Card.

name: Key Features Card
description: One card for the Cards slot of Key Features: image, heading and a Features slot of Key Features Item.

name: Key Features
description: Key Features of Our Spaces (Meetings): heading, text, button and a Cards slot of Key Features Card.

name: Room Template Styles
description: Numbered room detail rows (rich text) and amenities grid dividers for the CMS lists on the Room template.

name: FAQ Accordion
description: FAQ section listing every FAQ from the CMS by sort order.

name: Split Image Text Edge
description: Image at the left edge, text bottom right, optional second image. Used on room pages.

name: Split Image Text Edge Large
description: Edge layout with a larger heading and a bigger mobile image, optional second image. Used on Arts.

name: Split Image Text Wide
description: Large square image left, text right, optional second image. Used on Neighborhood.

name: Split Image Text Stagger Left
description: Wide image right, text below it on the left. Used on dining pages.

name: Split Image Text Stagger Mid
description: Wide image right, text below it in the middle. Used on Neighborhood.

name: Split Image Text Compact
description: Text left, image right, tight spacing. Used on package and story pages.

name: Form Photoshoot Request
description: Guidelines photoshoot request: script heading and the photoshoot form.

name: Form Request for Proposal
description: Meetings request for proposal: tall section with the event form.

name: Form Legal Corporate Proposal
description: Legal and corporate pages: proposal form with contact details.

name: Form Press Enquiries
description: Press page: intro, press email and the press form.

name: Contact Details Map
description: Contact page: heading, contact details, social links and the map.

name: Booking Menu Panel
description: The Book menu dialog (id book): image and four booking links. Lives inside Booking Menu.

name: Venue Detail Modal
description: Meeting venue pop-up (Meetings, Legal and Corporate): image, details, layout options, floorplan link, five features and the request button. CMS-bound.

name: Place Detail Modal
description: Neighborhood place pop-up: centred heading, image, text, learn more button, night image and text. CMS-bound.

name: Split Image Slide
description: One photo for the Slides slot of Split image text slider (History). Add as many as you like; the slider loops when there are 3 or more.
